text:
carla: FYI prospect sent an RFI asking for a concise capability matrix + POC acceptance checks. POC length = 2 weeks, must show: latency at 512 tokens, cost estimate, network options, KMS/HSM posture, and sample log export. Can we turn around a 1-pager + CSV by tomorrow morning?
tom: I can take the matrix columns. Thinking: Feature | Hosted | Dedicated | Private | Notes. Will include row entries for: 1) Auth (SSO/API keys), 2) Network (peering/PrivateLink), 3) KMS/HSM, 4) Audit log export, 5) Model verification, 6) Quantization support, 7) Estimated cost for 2-week POC.
jyoti: I'll draft the acceptance criteria (pass/fail) with numeric thresholds. Proposed quick numbers:
- Latency p95 (512 tokens): <= 450ms for Hosted in US-West
- Throughput: 50 reqs/s sustained for the test harness
- Cost: <= $1.20 per 1k tokens (POC average)
- Quality: human eval score no worse than 10% delta vs baseline
- Keying: customer-managed CMK present and verified

patrick: Networking notes: for VPC peering we need their CIDR and route table updates. PrivateLink needs subnets and ENI quotas checked. Firewall: allow egress to control plane on 443 and return flows. Also call out IP ranges we'll use and recommend a temporary security group for the POC.
carla: Good. Can someone add a small ops snippet for the customer to validate latency/cost quickly? We want them to be able to run an internal smoke test.
jyoti: Adding a tiny example (curl + jq) they can run: 
````
# smoke test: send single 512-token eval prompt
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.4","prompt":"<eval_payload>","max_tokens":512}' \
  https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate | jq '.latency_ms, .tokens'
````
patrick: For KMS: Hosted supports envelope encryption with customer CMK (cloud KMS). HSM-backed keys (FIPS/HSM) are available only on Private deployments; we can support BYOHSM there. 48h lead time for HSM provisioning during a POC.
tom: Pricing blurb (high level) I'll add to matrix: estimate for 2-week Hosted POC (4k reqs/day, avg 150 tokens) ≈ $650 usage. Dedicated short-term reservation is likely order-of-magnitude higher unless we provide trial credits or ephemeral node. Recommend offering $1k credit + waived setup for trial Dedicated consideration.
jyoti: Acceptance criteria table (short, to copy into RFI):
- Latency (p95, 512t): target <= 450ms — PASS if <= 500ms
- Throughput: target 50 req/s — PASS if sustained >= 40 req/s for 5 mins
- Cost: target <= $1.20 / 1k tokens — PASS if estimate <= $1.50
- Quality: target <= 10% BLEU/ROUGE delta — PASS if <= 15% delta or manual signoff
- Security: CMK present + audit log export configured — PASS when logs arrive in customer S3/Cloud account

carla: Nice. Legal wants a short sentence about logging and PII: "We do not persist customer prompt text in cleartext in our analytics; customers can request full retention export. For sensitive PII workflows recommend Private deployment."
legal-bot: Include attachment: redwood_poc_terms_short.pdf and security_artifacts_summary.pdf. (automated note: attachments saved under sales-docs/pocs/).
tom: I'll export the matrix CSV and attach to the RFI pack: sales-docs/pocs/piedmont-poc-matrix-1961.csv. Will mark cells that need customer input (CIDR, CMK ARN, desired retention days).
carla: Action items: tom = CSV + one-pager; jyoti = acceptance criteria + ops snippets; patrick = network checklist + lead times; I'll draft the email to the prospect. Aim to send by EOD.
patrick: One more: call out fallbacks — if quota exhausted we'll route to a smaller model (q4 variant) and note expected quality delta.
carla: Thanks team. If anyone wants me to include a short price table in the email, DM me numbers. Will send draft to #sales-review before sending to customer. :thumbsup:
